title: Environment Verification Snapshot
description: Rule 6 (Environment First) preamble artifact produced by 00_environment.sh. Documents the execution environment that every downstream metric extraction is computed against. Loaded by 09_compute_metrics.py and 10_render_report.py at read boundaries. The required-field list reflects the CP2 review contract: it includes repository_slug, default_branch, go_module_version, commit_date_range.earliest_utc / latest_utc / latest_on_main, in addition to the original Rule 6 set.

repository_url.description: Git remote URL with embedded auth credentials stripped (the producer applies a redact_url helper before writing). Example: https://github.com/Blitzy-Sandbox/blitzy-RudderStack.

repository_slug.description: Owner/repository slug derived from repository_url (e.g., 'Blitzy-Sandbox/blitzy-RudderStack'). Used as the path component for GitHub REST API calls in scripts/03_extract_pulls.py, 04_extract_releases.py, 06_extract_ci_history.py, and 07_extract_exceptions.py.

default_branch.description: Name of the repository's default branch as configured on GitHub (e.g., 'main'). The local-git inflection-point detection and the Releases API tag lookup both anchor on this branch name.

go_module_version.description: Go module language version sourced from the 'go' directive in go.mod (e.g., '1.26.1'). Recorded as part of Environment Verification because the rudder-server's build toolchain version is documented evidence in the Reproducibility Appendix (Rule 5).

go_module_version_source.description: Optional citation locator for go_module_version (e.g., 'go.mod:L3'). Provides Rule 1 (Data Provenance) traceability for the version string.

total_commit_count.description: Total commits reachable from HEAD as reported by `git rev-list --count HEAD`.

active_branch_count.description: Count of refs matching refs/heads/ and refs/remotes/origin/ at extraction time.

submodule_state.description: Derived from `git submodule status`: 'clean' if all submodules at expected SHAs, 'no_submodules' if .gitmodules absent or empty, 'dirty' if any submodule diverges.

earliest.description: Compatibility alias for earliest_utc. Earliest commit author date in ISO-8601 UTC (e.g., 2026-02-23T05:19:38Z). Retained for backward compatibility with the original Rule 6 contract; new consumers SHOULD read earliest_utc.

latest.description: Compatibility alias for latest_utc. Latest commit author date across --all refs in ISO-8601 UTC. New consumers SHOULD read latest_utc.

earliest_utc.description: Earliest commit author date across --all refs in ISO-8601 UTC. Canonical CP2-contract field name.

latest_utc.description: Latest commit author date across --all refs in ISO-8601 UTC. Canonical CP2-contract field name. May be later than latest_on_main because feature-branch activity (e.g., blitzy-* sandboxes) can extend beyond the most recent main merge.

latest_on_main.description: HEAD committer timestamp of the default branch ('main') in ISO-8601 UTC. Sourced from `git log -1 main --format='%cI'` and normalised to the Z form. Distinct from latest_utc, which spans --all refs.

earliest_aliases_note.description: Optional explanatory note documenting the compatibility-alias policy between earliest/earliest_utc and latest/latest_utc. Producers MAY emit this note for human readability; consumers MUST NOT depend on it.

latest_vs_latest_on_main_note.description: Optional explanatory note documenting why latest_utc and latest_on_main may differ (feature-branch activity past the last main merge).

latest_on_main_source_command.description: Optional citation of the exact shell command used to compute latest_on_main. Provides Rule 1 (Data Provenance) traceability.

extraction_timestamp.description: Wall-clock timestamp at which the environment snapshot was captured, ISO-8601 UTC.

run_id.description: Per-run correlation ID (UUID4) generated by 00_environment.sh and propagated via BLITZY_RUN_ID.

inflection_date_utc.description: Optional canonical AI-introduction inflection point sourced from data/inflection.json#date_utc. When present, carries the same value as inflection.json#date_utc, metrics.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc, per_engineer.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc, and pulls.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc (Rule 4 Internal Consistency, AAP §0.5.6). Optional rather than required because 00_environment.sh runs BEFORE 01_detect_inflection.py in the pipeline and therefore has no source for the inflection date at its execution phase. Producers that have already computed the inflection date (e.g., the hand-authored seed, or a re-run that injects BLITZY_INFLECTION_DATE_UTC into the environment) MAY emit this field; consumers MUST NOT depend on it being present in environment.json — the canonical source remains data/inflection.json#date_utc.
